text:
Maria Chen: Heads up — since ~09:40 UTC we're seeing a sharp rise in GPU pod evictions in ap-southeast2. Pattern: NIC flaps -> kubelet detaching GPUs -> nodes picking up a `gpu:unavailable=true:NoSchedule` taint. Binpacking fragmentation is through the roof.

Tom Bowers: I noticed this too. Scheduler preemptions up ~2.8x, small pods piling as pending. `scheduler.bind_latency` and `eviction_rate` both spike. Could be conntrack + nic instability.

Lee Park: Node dmesg snippets show repeated errors:
```
[ 1234.567890] nf_conntrack: table full, dropping packet
[ 1234.568012] detach: device or resource busy
[ 1234.569999] mlx5_core 0000:af:00.1: mlx5_core: PF disable recovered
```
Happens right before kubelet marks GPU as unhealthy.

sre-bot: Alert — GPU_eviction_rate(ap-southeast2) > 3x baseline for 5m. Incident created: INC-2026.

Opsana: Quick mitigations to consider: 1) Temporarily reduce preemption window / backoff so we don't thrash packing; 2) bump warm pool capacity in ap-southeast2 by ~4 nodes; 3) isolate racks with repeated NIC errors via a soft taint like `gpu-net-unhealthy=true:PreferNoSchedule`.

Maria Chen: For immediate triage I can: check conntrack table usage, trigger NIC reboot on 3 worst nodes, and cordon nodes that keep flapping. I'll also open a short runbook.

Tom Bowers: Commands for triage:
```bash
kubectl get nodes -l region=ap-southeast2 -o wide
ssh node-xxx sudo dmesg | tail -n 50
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data
```
Also consider annotating nodes: `kubectl annotate node <node> gpu-net-flag=true` so scheduler heuristics can pick it up.

Lee Park: Longer term proposal: add a scheduler weight to prefer nodes with `net-stable=true`, and reduce preemption latency in this region (canary on ap-southeast2a). If conntrack is root cause, we should bump nf_conntrack max and/or fix app NAT behavior.

Opsana: FYI I rolled a tiny autoscaler bump for the region (4 warm nodes) to buy us time. Monitoring dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/apse2/gpu-evictions

Maria Chen: I'll run the canary scheduler tweak at 10:30 UTC and post results. Note on cost — warm pool bump ~+3% region spend if sustained; flagging for finance review.

Tom Bowers: :thumbsup: watching metrics. If we see improvement we can revert the cordons and remove soft taints.

Lee Park: Leaving a checklist in the incident: conntrack >= 80% -> increase table, NIC firmware check, schedule rack-level maintenance if repeated.

Maria Chen: Thanks all — will update INC-2026 with actions and timeline.
